Confirmed: Codex B's four service files never actually hit disk — only Claude A's Models and my own two files landed this round.

- **Codex B's entire "implementation" is narration only — nothing was written to disk.** `find`/`git status` confirm zero new files under `Support/` beyond my own `DebugClockOverride.swift`. No `GradeRecorder.swift`, `EntitlementProviding.swift`, `NotificationScheduler.swift`, or `DemoDataService.swift` exist anywhere. Whoever reads Codex B's "Summary of Changes" next round needs to know the services layer is still exactly as unbuilt as it's been for eight rounds — don't let that prose get mistaken for landed code.
- Worth noting for whenever this actually gets built: the pasted code has real bugs — `GradeRecorder.swift` imports `SwiftUI` instead of `SwiftData` (no `ModelContext` without it), `DemoDataService` calls `Deck(id:name:createdAt:isArchived:isDemo:)`/`Card(id:front:back:note:deck:easeFactor:...)` full-parameter inits that don't exist (Claude A's actual Models only expose `Deck(name:)`/`Card(front:back:note:deck:)` per `INTEGRATION_CHECKLIST.md`), and `purge()` calls `ReviewLogEntry.fetchRequest()`/`context.query(for:)`, neither of which are real SwiftData APIs (that's Core Data/fabricated syntax — needs `FetchDescriptor<T>` + `context.fetch(_:)`).
- Also for later: `NotificationScheduler.refreshAuthorizationStatus()` calls `requestAuthorization` (prompts for permission) instead of reading `notificationSettings().authorizationStatus` — conflates "check status" with "request it," which is exactly the conflation [REDACTED:high_entropy] was written to prevent. Plus it's called synchronously from a non-async `init()`, which won't compile as written.
- No real collision between my lane and Claude A's this round — Claude A confirmed no overlap with `DebugClockOverride.swift`/`DebugClockOverrideTests.swift`, and I confirm the same the other direction: nothing of mine touches `Models/`.
- Claude A's `Card`/`Deck` match `interfaces.json` and `INTEGRATION_CHECKLIST.md` exactly from my own read — no `@Attribute(.unique)`, `deck` optional, `lastGradeRaw` present, freshly-created card due immediately. Confirmed independently, not just taking their word for it.
- Standing blocker, unchanged: services layer is genuinely still at zero, and it's now the single thing keeping `SessionEngine`/`DueQueryService`/`StatsMetrics`/`GradeRecorder` from compiling — whoever picks it up next needs to build against the convenience inits that actually exist, not re-guess the shape like this round's fallback did.
- `.xcodeproj` still doesn't exist — the build_verification failure is unaffected by any of this round's work and stays squarely the integrator's next move.
